name: SteamVeil / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A taut soaked tissue snap and a bright pressurized steam jet, followed by sustained hot vapor hissing, wet sputters and cooling water droplets. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
